papers.title: Species-Resolved Citation Network Data for Cardiac Regeneration Research, 2000–2026
papers.summary: Bibliographic source data, citation edges, species-resolved fractional citation edges, analysis outputs, and code for a cross-species citation-flow analysis of cardiac regeneration research (9,893 papers; 63,788 edges).

papers.title: Transdifferentiation Topic Dynamics in Bone-Marrow Cardiac Regeneration: Data and Analysis
papers.summary: Derived data and analysis code for a longitudinal study of transdifferentiation-topic presence in bone-marrow cardiac-regeneration literature, 2000–2025 (source frozen 23 Oct 2026).

papers.title: ElectroTrace: reproducible ECG/electrophysiology annotation and benchmarking
papers.summary: Research software for ECG/electrophysiology annotation, detector benchmarking, leakage-aware validation, provenance, and calibration-grade ECG/EAM handoffs.
